name: dotenvup-monorepo
description: .env files, but with memory — and a lock. Encrypted .env.up format and tools.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@dotenvup/format && npm run build --workspace=@dotenvup/cli --workspace=@dotenvup/node --workspace=@dotenvup/mcp --workspace=@dotenvup/secret-generator --workspace=dotenvup
scripts.release:verify: npm run security:check && npm run build && npm test
scripts.release:verify:full: npm run security:check && npm run security:sast && npm run build && npm test
scripts.package:extension: npm run build && npm run package --workspace=dotenvup
scripts.publish:extension: npm run release:verify && (cd packages/vscode-dotenvup && npx @vscode/vsce publish --no-dependencies)
scripts.publish:openvsx: npm run release:verify && (cd packages/vscode-dotenvup && npx ovsx publish --no-dependencies)
